mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `share` (`task_id`,`sharer_id`, `shared_time`, `due_time`, `receiver_id`, `company_id`, `password`) VALUES( #{shares.taskId}, #{shares.sharerId}, #{shares.sharedTime}, IF(#{shares.dueTime} = #{shares.sharedTime}, NULL, #{shares.dueTime}), IF(#{shares.receiverId} = -2, NULL, #{shares.receiverId}), IF(#{shares.companyId} = -2, NULL, #{shares.companyId}), #{shares.password})
mapper.update: UPDATE share SET password = #{password}, due_time = #{dueTime}, receiver_id = IF(#{receiverId} = -2, NULL, #{receiverId}), company_id = IF(#{companyId} = -2, NULL, #{companyId}) WHERE share_id = #{shareId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, s.share_id, s.sharer_id, s.receiver_id, s.company_id, s.shared_time, s.due_time, s.password, receiver.user_name as receiver_name, c.company_name FROM scmoannotask t JOIN share s ON t.task_id = s.task_id LEFT JOIN scMoAnnoUser receiver ON s.receiver_id = receiver.user_id LEFT JOIN company c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE t.uploader_id = #{userID} ORDER BY s.shared_time DESC;

SELECT * FROM scmoannotask t JOIN share s ON t.task_id = s.task_id LEFT JOIN scMoAnnoUser sharer ON s.sharer_id = sharer.user_id LEFT JOIN company c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE ( -- 直接分享给个人 s.receiver_id = #{userID} OR -- 分享给公司（用户属于该公司） (s.company_id IS NOT NULL AND s.company_id = ( SELECT company_id FROM scMoAnnoUser WHERE user_id = #{userID} )) ) AND (s.due_time IS NULL OR s.due_time > NOW()) -- 排除已过期的分享 ORDER BY s.shared_time DESC;

SELECT s.share_id, s.task_id, s.sharer_id, s.receiver_id, s.company_id, s.password, s.shared_time, s.due_time, sharer.user_name as sharer_name, receiver.user_name as receiver_name, task.task_name, company.company_name, sharer.avatar as sharerAvatarBase64 FROM share s LEFT JOIN scMoAnnoUser sharer ON s.sharer_id = sharer.user_id LEFT JOIN scMoAnnoUser receiver ON s.receiver_id = receiver.user_id LEFT JOIN scMoAnnoTask task ON s.task_id = task.task_id LEFT JOIN company ON s.company_id = company.company_id ORDER BY s.shared_time DESC
